narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>They are not co-prime, because neither number is prime.
<bookmark mark='eight'/>But look at eight and nine, which are not prime, and have no prime in common.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Co-prime only asks whether a factor is shared, never whether the numbers are prime.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>List the primes of each number, and if no prime is in both lists, the numbers are co-prime.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. Fourteen is two times seven, and fifteen is three times five. Are they co-prime?
